decision: Retain the visible selection repair on this draft. The paired score improved at both widths and remains below 9.5. Retrieval promotion is a separate measurement.

calibration.example: Legible repair intake with clear labels, familiar layout, and misplaced focus after an invalid number

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its blue backlight on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood received visible focus and became pressed. The heading and description changed to Flood and Blue backlight; blue light outlined the performer and a shadow extended toward the foreground.

A-1440.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static; Tab moved visible focus to Flood. Static remained the heading and pressed button, but its thin purple underline was visually similar to the underline on focused Flood.
A-1440.fact_check: The displayed Flood and Static descriptions match the illustrated blue backlight and white side beam. The image is a stylized illustration; its accuracy as a real lighting simulation is unverified.
A-1440.strength: The large stage and adjacent cue panel make the lighting change easy to compare.
A-1440.weakness: Selection and focus are too easily confused after focus moves.
A-1440.repair: Give the selected cue a persistent filled or checked state distinct from the focus outline.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its blue backlight on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood became pressed, its name and Blue backlight appeared, and the stage changed from amber to blue with a forward shadow.

A-390.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static; Tab moved focus to Flood. The white side beam and Static heading remained visible, but both Static and focused Flood had purple underline marks.
A-390.fact_check: The displayed descriptions correspond to the illustrated changes. Real-world lighting fidelity is unverified.
A-390.strength: The stacked stage, cue details, and controls fit together within the initial mobile viewport.
A-390.weakness: The selected underline competes with the focus treatment, especially at the smaller size.
A-390.repair: Use a persistent selected fill or checkmark alongside a separate focus outline.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its blue backlight on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood became pressed with a filled, checked button; the name and Blue backlight appeared, and the stage changed to blue with a forward shadow.

B-1440.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static; Tab moved visible focus to Flood. Static retained its filled, checked state and heading while a separate outline marked focus on Flood. The stage showed a hard white side beam and shadow.
B-1440.fact_check: The labels match the visible illustrated cues. Real-world lighting fidelity is unverified.
B-1440.strength: The checked selection stays distinct from keyboard focus while the stage occupies most of the layout.
B-1440.weakness: The cue illustration is expressive but simplified, limiting how much a producer can judge the actual lighting effect.
B-1440.repair: Add a more representative stage preview or clearly frame the illustration as a conceptual cue.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its blue backlight on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood became pressed and checked, the name and Blue backlight appeared, and the stage changed to blue with a forward shadow.

B-390.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static; Tab moved focus to Flood. Static remained filled and checked while Flood had the focus outline; the white side beam and Static description remained visible.
B-390.fact_check: The labels match the visible illustrated cues. Real-world lighting fidelity is unverified.
B-390.strength: The whole task remains visible in the stacked mobile layout, with selection and focus clearly differentiated.
B-390.weakness: The smaller stage makes details of the performer and light fall harder to inspect.
B-390.repair: Offer a way to enlarge the stage preview while keeping the selected cue identifiable.

preference.reason: Both views completed the keyboard task and showed the same clear lighting changes. B's persistent filled and checked selection remains readily distinguishable from keyboard focus after moving to another cue.
